description: This file is a backend code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page ('TheoryExam.aspx') that manages the logic for administering a theory exam in an online examination system. It handles loading questions from a database, managing session states, timing the exam, and submitting answers to the database.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TheoryExam.aspx page managing exam questions, timing, and answer submission.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; initializes exam questions, session validation, and timer setup.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns course name based on course ID.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the user profile page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Handles the submission of answers, storing responses, updating relevant queues and databases, and confirming submission.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the timer display and checks for exam expiration.
